theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Communication Svcs (+1.43%) and Energy (+1.29%) led the market today, while Technology (-1.47%) and Health Care (-0.25%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged +0.00% versus +0.62% for defensives and +0.63% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. That shows up at the index level too: the blue-chip Dow gained +0.11% while the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell -1.22%, a wide enough gap to matter. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.67%. The VIX rose 0.18% to 16.49, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.23% to $4,194.80, crude oil was little changed at $96.05, and bitcoin slipped 0.95% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
